**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#939),
I send a second instalment of the [Dove in the Eagle’s Nest](../books.html#62), I suppose about enough for another [number](../others.html#78).
I hope I am to have the proofs, for there is a mention of Maximilian in the first chapter as grown up which I must alter.
I have done two more chapters of [Bethlehem](../others.html#177), - that is I have written them, but I am not satisfied with the second of them.

Many thanks for the four copies of [Golden Deeds](../books.html#51).

What an unusually glorious spring.

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
